open: 1. **Density {density} a minute, not ~12.** Plan v2 marked most beats silent beat by beat (G9/G10: statements, counters, typing, UI demos), and the body cap (7 in 30 s) binds in the intro and 'Why now'. Reaching ~100 would mean sounds on text or minor elements, which the card's 2026-10-26 rule and the brief exclude. The Editor decides whether to lift the 5 auto swooshes that gave way.

2. **Bus gain is a model number.** +{gain} dB assumes the mono lav plays at 0 dB in both channels. If A1 is a mono track with a -3 dB centre pan law, the render sits ~3 dB lower and needs ~+{gain3} dB. Read the review render's integrated loudness (`ffmpeg -i <render> -af ebur128=peak=true -f null -`) and set the main bus to -16 LUFS with a true-peak limiter at -1 dBTP (or Deliver's loudness normalisation if the main session confirms it in Resolve 21).

3. **`--dry` is not side-effect free and needs Resolve.** place_sound_locked.py connects to Resolve and takes the lab lock before anything, and sound_place.py's `--dry` still imports every file into the 'Sound (Editor)' bin and adds audio tracks up to A6 (AddTrack and ImportMedia run before the DRY check). So it was not run here; the plan was validated offline instead (merge checks + mix check). If the Editor runs `--dry`, the next real run still passes the A2+ check (tracks are added, no items placed).

4. **Nothing has been listened to.** Spots to hear on the review render: 0 (open), 697 (Yuma -> Shadowed), 1443-1450 (IN-02 hit on Bahamas), 1964-2004 (riser into WN-02), 4741 (T1-02), 7816-8040 (Pinpoint under the Mid-CTA and the MC-02 'Research' beep), 8085 (T2-02), 9750 (EN-01 shutter), 11639 (outro).

5. A fix round was rebuilding 12 units while this ran. Re-run the one-line chain after it lands; any pin that moved is printed as drift, any pin it cannot find is printed as UNRESOLVED and keeps its 2026-10-29 frame.
6. Voice Isolation 44 on A1 and the A1 +6 dB per clip are the main session's (not in sound_place's plan).
